verdict.rationale: Notion documents a public REST API that can read, create, and update nearly everything in a workspace (pages, databases, users, comments). It offers personal access tokens, internal-connection tokens, and OAuth for auth, plus webhooks and Agent session APIs, and probes confirm a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of driving the product end-to-end via the API, and coverage of the parts not reachable by the API (docs say 'nearly everything')
